text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today's my day off. While strolling near
the student dormitories, I
catch a glimpse
of a familiar face.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Hey Trainer, whatcha doin'?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Eh, not much goin' on—just killing time.
Can't help but feel restless on
my days off.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Oh hey, I got an idea! You know what
would be fun? Bikes!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeah! ...is what I'd like to say,
but I
don't actually own a
motorbike myself... or
proper protection for that matter.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Whiiich is why we're going to a motorbike
shop! C'mon, let's go check
out the new
models!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Whooooa! Trainer, check this out! It's the
UMAHA ZX750.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Would ya look at the size of that tank!
And despite the bulk, such a streamlined,
modern body design! Oh man, as soon as
you rev up that engine, you'll become one
with the wind!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Daaamn, this is awesome!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what? What's with that look? I'm
passionate about bikes, okay?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
My pops is a huge fan of 'em, and he'd
always let me ride on the
back.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
But I guess it doesn't really matter
'cause I can't buy it anyway. Just
like winning the
Derby, it's not something I can easily get
my hands on.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Win what? You mean like, the Derby?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Whoa, whoa, whoa. So I can make my dreams come true and get a sick ride? I like the way you think!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
It's a promise between us then!
I feel like I
can do anything with you!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Holy crap, I'm all fired up! I can't just
stand still here... I'm gonna... I'm
gonna...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna charge straight down to the
beach! I may not have my ride
yet... but my
own two legs will do!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Raaaaargh!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Vodka sprints away at full speed, as I
chase her with all my might... in
a taxi.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Whew, that felt good. It's nice runnin' on
the road instead of the turf
from time to
time.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
The ocean breeze feels so good... If this
moment isn't the definition
of cool, then I
don't know what is.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer, this might sound a little
strange, but... is there a
difference
between being cool and being strong?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I've always aimed to be cool rather than
strong. To me, being strong
is already a
part of being cool.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Like, you know that time everyone
laughed at me 'cause I put on airs
after I
lost? It's been on my mind ever since.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
When it comes to being cool, my pops
takes the cake. As for being
strong, well,
that's my mom.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Curious, I listen to Vodka as she begins
talking about her parents.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
My pops is a biker.
He didn't participate in
races, but we'd always go out on rides
together. Thanks to him, I got to go to a
bunch of different places.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Pops certainly had a way with words—he'd
always tell me to live my
life on the edge,
and let my tears dry in the wind!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
But my mom was the total opposite! She
basically ran the whole house, and would
kick Pops's butt when he didn't have his
act
together.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
When she ran, she was as fast as a
motorbike! Dirt or pavement—she
was
always a contender for first.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
They really are. But I always found myself
following in my pops's
footsteps. Well, I
guess it was bound to happen.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Maybe it would've been better to chase
after my mom instead, but I
just couldn't
see myself doing that.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Hey, do you think I've got it all
wrong? Is
it weird that my goal is to
become the
coolest?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Really? Well,
if you don't think it's weird,
then maybe I'm on the right
track after all.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Sometimes I get dumb new ideas into my
head, and they just bug me,
y'know?
Anyway, it's getting late—let's head back.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: On the way back...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Pops used to take me on rides through
streets like these. Just, like, to
the factory
where he worked, or the local eateries and
stuff.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
So it's not like we were goin' out for
fun.
But...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
No matter where he was heading, he'd
always bring me along if I
wanted. All I
had to do was ask.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Wha—! Don't say embarrassin' stuff like
that! But... I guess you're
right, yeah.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
My pops shaped me into the person I am
today. It's thanks to him that
I'm here
now...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
(I can still hear it...
The exhaust pipe of my
pops's 250. The warmth
of the arm revving
the engine...)

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
No doubt about it,
this is my path forward.
'Cause...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
At the end of this road lies the
coolest me
there'll ever be!
